headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Siddaramaiah says he won’t contest 2028 Assembly polls, cites age.
Gadkari assures help for Telangana’s infrastructure push.
Wild tusker enters captive camp in Mysuru, kills male elephant.
TVK MLA V.S. Babu, who defeated M.K. Stalin in Kolathur, passes away.
Eight booked for allegedly assaulting Payyannur MLA’s private secretary during public meeting.
bullets_ur: Siddaramaiah ka 2028 ke Assembly intikhabat na larnay ka elaan, umr ko wajah qarar diya.
Gadkari ne Telangana ke infrastructure mansoobon ke liye madad ki yaqeen dahani karwai.
Mysuru mein jungli haathi camp mein daakhil, ek nar haathi ko maar daala.
Kolathur mein M.K. Stalin ko harane wale TVK ke MLA V.S. Babu inteqal kar gaye.
